_comment: Single source of truth for hosts. Flip storeLive to true ONLY after store.ayasura.com serves WooCommerce, and production to true on launch day — see migration/CUTOVER_RUNBOOK.md. Before storeLive, shop/legacy redirects and Buy links point at legacyOrigin (the current live WordPress). production=false keeps the site noindex with a Disallow-all robots.txt (staging); production=true removes noindex, publishes a sitemap and uses the apex as the canonical site.
